diagnostics.message: The explicit dependency from `:resource.time_sleep.wait_for_aws_s3_bucket_settings` to `:resource.aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block.origin` is redundant: the sleep already depends on `:resource.aws_s3_bucket_policy.default`, which itself depends on the public access block.

The explicit dependency from `:resource.aws_cloudfront_distribution.default` to `:resource.time_sleep.wait_for_aws_s3_bucket_settings` is redundant: the distribution also depends on `:resource.aws_s3_bucket_ownership_controls.origin`, which in turn depends on the sleep resource.

The explicit dependency from `:resource.aws_cloudfront_distribution.default` to `:resource.aws_s3_bucket.origin` duplicates the dependency implied by the distribution's origin domain name, which is derived from the created S3 bucket through `local.origin_bucket`.
